name: flag-off
description: Turns a LaunchDarkly feature flag off in one environment through the LaunchDarkly API. Only turning a flag off is supported, and no other environment of the flag changes. A flag that is already off or archived is refused, and so is an environment that requires approvals or a flag with a scheduled change or an active workflow in that environment. Allowed: project quillcart-web, environments production, staging, flags checkout-*, promo-*.

project.description: The key of the LaunchDarkly project.

environment.description: The key of the environment. Only this environment of the flag changes.

flag.description: The key of the feature flag.

change.description: turn_off turns the flag off in this environment.
